_comment: Painted sheets define the palette and, per facing, the standing cell (4x4 grid, row 0) the repaint copies identity from.
identity: a chibi young traveler: soft messy silver-grey hair with painted highlights, large warm brown eyes, dark teal hooded coat with cream trim and visible stitching, bulky cream scarf, brown leather shoulder strap and belt with a gold buckle, cream sleeve bands and brown bracers, dark trousers, tall brown boots, dark sheathed sword with gold fittings at the left hip, brown satchel on the back
